question: In the American Academy of Actuaries' 2011 RFP for retirement plan and related consulting services, what were the plan assets at 12/31/10 of each of its three retirement plans?
gold_answer: Money Purchase plan: $3,015,682; 401(k) plan: $1,993,513; Defined Benefit plan: $647,181 (all as of 12/31/10).
acceptance: Accept amounts mapped correctly to Money Purchase, 401(k), and Defined Benefit; profit-sharing description is optional.
candidate_answer:
The American Academy of Actuaries’ RFP lists these plan assets as of December 31, 2010:

| Retirement plan | Plan assets |
|---|---:|
| Money purchase pension plan | $3,015,682 |
| 401(k) profit-sharing plan | $1,993,513 |
| Defined benefit plan | $647,181 |

[Source: 2011 RFP, p. 2](American_Academy_of_Actuaries__RFP__AmericanAcademyofActuaries_RetirementPlanService_110512.pdf#page=2)
